decisions.decision: One generic game-muted button state for phase, pause, dead, silenced and burnout; no cause text or tooltip
decisions.why: AC-11: silenced must not be distinguishable by UI

decisions.decision: No muted icon or marker on other players' list rows or Mod3D desks; speaking indicator is presence-only
decisions.why: Absence of indicator must carry no information

decisions.decision: Silenced player told privately by appending a sentence to the existing silence chat placeholder and vote card text
decisions.why: Brief allows private notice in existing silence notice; no new channel

decisions.decision: Self speaking ring only when permitted and not self-muted
decisions.why: Avoids a local tell for the silenced player and follows server gate

decisions.decision: Mod3D desk indicator is a billboard sprite over the nameplate, hidden when not speaking
decisions.why: Follows desk movement like the audio panner; no mute icon needed

decisions.decision: Reduced-motion: static bars and arcs; indicator never colour-only

summary: design.md + static spec canvas for 7 UI ACs; privacy-safe single game-muted state
